description: Create a fresh random base32 secret, optionally with an otpauth:// URI for authenticator apps.

account.description: Account name, e.g. alice@example.com (adds the otpauth URI)

digits.description: Code digits for the URI, default 6

issuer.description: Issuer name shown in the app

period.description: Step seconds for the URI, default 30

name: generate_secret
